headlines.headline: Maruti Suzuki, Reliance Industries, Bharti Airtel and others: 17 NIFTY50 stocks that are near their 52-week lows; check full list
headlines.summary: On a year-on-year basis, the NIFTY50 index has, however, declined 10.5%, while NIFTY Midcap 100 and NIFTY Smallcap 100 have gained 0.6% and 6.6%, respectively.

headlines.headline: Accenture shares soar 70% in three months, while TCS remains flat: Decoding the IT divergence
headlines.summary: TCS and Accenture are two of the top two global IT giants, operating in similar verticals. While Accenture shares have witnessed a sharp rebound from lower levels, the Indian peer continues to face selling pressure.

headlines.headline: TCS, ITC, Hexaware Tech among buzzing stocks as SENSEX, NIFTY50 rally over 1% in noon deals
headlines.summary: Pidlilite Industries shares climbed as much as 2% to hit an intraday high of ₹1,488.90 apiece on the NSE, as its board of directors approved the appointment of Amith Agarwal as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) with effect from October 9, 2026.

headlines.headline: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech: Nifty IT rallies over 3% despite US suspending eight firms from green-card programme
headlines.summary: Nifty IT surged over 3% on October 9, as investors focused on the US suspension of 8 companies from a green-card programme having no impact and TCS's latest earnings report.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank's Anup Bagchi set for ₹36-crore annual pay, ₹7.35-cr joining bonus; Here's his salary breakdown
headlines.summary: Anup Bagchi will take charge as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of HDFC Bank later this month, succeeding Sashidhar Jagdishan.

headlines.headline: TCS shares jump 6%: Q2 results boost sentiment; US PERM suspension unlikely to have an impact
headlines.summary: The development has raised questions about its potential implications for Indian IT companies, although TCS has said it does not expect the suspension to affect its workforce strategy or customer engagements

headlines.headline: SENSEX jumps 400 points; NIFTY50 opens at 22,314; TCS, HCL Tech, Infosys, other IT stocks lead pack of gainers
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices surged after the opening bell on Friday, October 9, amid earnings momentum in IT stocks, a pullback in US Treasury yields and a fall in crude oil prices.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 9: Hexaware Tech, TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, ITC, JSW Steel,  Cochin Shipyard, NCC
headlines.summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) kicked off the Q2 earnings season on Thursday, reporting a 15% year-on-year rise in net profit to ₹13,884 crore, compared with ₹12,075 crore a year ago and ₹13,349 crore in the preceding quarter

headlines.headline: ITC block deals: GQG Partners sells 2.91% stake for ₹9,395 crore; check buyers’ list
headlines.summary: The shares were sold at an average price of ₹257.35 apiece, for a total deal value of ₹9,395.44 crore. The transaction comes as GQG Partners continues to pare its holdings in Indian companies.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 8: AEL tumbles 5%, JSW Steel, ITC, Max Healthcare shares fall 4%; check list
headlines.summary: On October 8, the 30-share BSE SENSEX slumped 1,045.46 points or 1.44% to close at 71,593.24. The 50-share NIFTY fell by 371.25 points or 1.64% to end at 22,231.80.

headlines.headline: TCS Q2 FY27: AI revenue hits $3.1 billion, crosses 10% of total revenue; check two key deals
headlines.summary: The IT company’s revenue from core operations advanced 11.2% to ₹73,188 crore in the period under review, from ₹65,799 crore in the same period a year earlier.

headlines.headline: TCS Q2 results: Net profit rises 15% to ₹13,884 crore, revenue jumps 11% YoY; TCV rises to $9.6 billion
headlines.summary: TCS posted a 15% YoY rise in profits in the Q2 results, along with a ₹12/share second interim dividend for shareholders on Thursday, October 8.

headlines.headline: TCS board declares second interim dividend of ₹12 per share; check record, payment dates
headlines.summary: The second interim dividend, TCS said, will be paid on Friday, October 30, 2026, to the eligible equity shareholders of the company.

headlines.headline: Market Wrap, Oct 8: SENSEX plunges 1,045 pts, NIFTY sinks 1.6% as oil tops $104; over ₹10 lakh crore wiped out
headlines.summary: The NIFTY50 index hit 52-week low of 22,179.90 during the session. All sectoral indices ended in the red, while the midcap and smallcap indices underperformed the benchmark indices.

headlines.headline: SENSEX tanks over 1,100 pts, NIFTY trades below 22,200; Senco Gold, TCS, Fino Payments Bank among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Shares of Fino Payments Bank rallied as much as 16.8% to hit an intraday high of ₹150.40 per unit, as the Bank reported a 13% YoY surge in its average total deposits to ₹2,794 crore in Q2 FY27.
